title: Online Model Adaptation in Cold Rolling for Improvement of Thickness Precision
findings: Adaptation requires synchronized valid measurements; RLS uses an identified linear-load region. Assumes parameter drift slower than measurement transport delay; updates are rate-limited.
weaknesses_conflicts: Laboratory steel example. Does not define a universal startup speed. Process variance was not computed; observed map derivatives may disagree. No project controller implemented.
